title: Pro:Direct Sport
meta_description: Download the Pro:Direct Sport App for the best in sport & sport fashion shopping
full_description: WE ARE SPORTSince taking our first online order in 1998, we’ve been dedicated to serving customers across the world who share our passion for sport. Now, to celebrate our landmark 25th anniversary, we’re excited to launch the Pro:Direct Sport app – a slick, quick and easy-to-use app which brings the best of premium sport performance to your mobile device. Our app will continually evolve to match our customers' expectations, as well as our ongoing ambition to inspire and serve the sport obsessed.ONE PRO:DIRECT SPORT APP – PERSONALISED TO YOUFor the first time, enjoy the best of Pro:Direct Sport all in one place and personalise your experience to the sports that matter to you – from our wide range of specialist sports including Soccer, Running, Basketball, Rugby, Tennis, Cricket & Golf. Discover your personalised discover feed and enjoy the best in premium sports performance and lifestyle product from Pro:Direct Sport, all in a single place and with a single basket. APP-EXCLUSIVE MEMBERSHIPDownload the Pro:Direct Sport app today to become a Pro Member for FREE and gain access to sport’s best products, stories and communities. Enjoy serious perks with your Pro Membership, only available in the Pro:Direct Sport app, which unlocks benefits including:- Pro Member Welcome Offer – 10% off your first in-app order*- Pro Member Birthday Bonus – 10% off one item on your birthday*- Members Only Launches – Get exclusive access to member-only launches and limited edition drops that are available only in the Pro:Direct Sport app.- Release & Restock Reminders – We’ll keep an eye on the launch calendar for you, so you never miss a drop that matters to you.- Member Only Sales & Promotions- Member Only Events & Experiences- Free Boot Room & Fan Store Personalisation- Anniversary Offer – Exclusive offers and more great rewards each year you’re with us.Upgrade to Elite Membership, and gain additional benefits for just £14.95 per year including:- Level Up Offer – 20% off your first order as an Elite Member*- Elite Member Birthday Bonus – 20% off one item on your birthday*- Pro:Direct Premier Delivery – Unlimited Next Business Day Delivery & Priority Order Processing**- Pro:Direct Priority Access – Stay a step ahead. Get first access to the latest launches, hottest events, and exclusive member releases.- Private Sales & Exclusive Promotions- Anniversary Offer – Exclusive offers and more great rewards each year you’re with us.*   Excludes Items already on Sale, and also excludes certain new releases** Next Business Day based on when your item is dispatched from usCHOICE AT YOUR FINGERTIPSEffortlessly browse upcoming launches and the latest releases from a curated selection of over 180 world-leading sports performance and lifestyle brands including Nike, Air Jordan, adidas, PUMA, New Balance, Diadora, Mizuno, ASICS, HOKA, Saucony, The North Face and many more.STORIES THAT INFORM & INSPIREGet exclusive access to in-depth stories, training and style advice from players and athletes from your chosen sports, only in the Pro:Direct Sport app.STAY IN THE KNOWSign up to tailored notifications for the latest drops, promotions, events, competitions, and order updates.SHOPPING AS IT SHOULD BEBrowse and shop across our wide range of specialist sports in a single place, with a single basket. Shop for you and the family, with our range of performance and lifestyle products for Men, Women, and Kids of all ages and sporting abilities.Use our quick and easy checkout, with a wide range of delivery options, including Next or Named Day Delivery across the UK from carriers that you trust and get updates on your order every step of the way to your door.Shopping Features:-	Fast, intuitive browsing-	Powerful search and filtering-	Save items for later-	Streamlined checkout including Google Pay-	Play Now and Pay Later with flexible payment optionsThe Pro:Direct Sport app is currently available in the UK only
